notes.title: Re-announcement of past update information
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "SAMURAI MAIDEN". 

Since its release in December 2022, this game has undergone many updates based on your feedback.
As part of the updates, the costumes "Durable Bath Towel" and free DLC“Tsumugi's Costume: Uniform (In Water and Dream)”, which were not available at the time of release, have now been implemented.

If you have not yet obtained these costumes, please take this opportunity to enjoy them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42719273/9eb82df0176cc59c1c854ce2197005675103a9e9.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2148411/

We look forward to your continued support of "SAMURAI MAIDEN".

Thanks!
Team Samurai Maiden

notes.title: Update Information Apr. 26, 2024
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "SAMURAI MAIDEN". The following updates have been made.

[h3]Update Information[/h3]
[b]- New costume "Durable Bath Towel" has been added.
  *It can be purchased using in-game currency.

- Added "Underworld Hot Spring" to the camp background.
  *It can be changed in the options menu.

- Adjusted the AI of enemy characters.
- Steam trading cards are now supported.
[/b]
We look forward to your continued support of "SAMURAI MAIDEN".

Thanks!
Team Samurai Maiden

notes.title: Update Information Feb. 20, 2024
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "SAMURAI MAIDEN".
The following updates have been made.

[h3]Update Information[/h3]

[b]- Tsumugi's movement speed has been increased.
- Tsumugi's attack speed and range have been improved.
- Characters are no longer damaged by bombs and time bombs.
- The damage caused by falling has been eliminated.
- The camera distance now changes depending on the scene.
- The camera angle changes during lock-on are now smoother.
- Other minor bugs have been fixed.[/b]

We look forward to your continued support of "SAMURAI MAIDEN".

Thanks!
Team Samurai Maiden

notes.title: Update Information Jan. 12, 2023
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "SAMURAI MAIDEN".
The following updates have been made.

[h3]Update Information[/h3]
[b]-Added the ability to hide the help bar on the "Memory Fragments" viewing screen.
-The mouse cursor is now always fixed to the center of the primary monitor when the mouse cursor is not displayed during battle.
With this improvement, the mouse cursor no longer moves out of range of the primary screen when the camera is operated with the mouse during battle.
-When selecting a difficulty level, the initial position of the difficulty level selection cursor now automatically selects the difficulty level selected in the previous sortie.
[/b]

We look forward to your continued support of "SAMURAI MAIDEN".

Thanks!
Team Samurai Maiden

notes.title: Update Information Dec. 23, 2022
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "SAMURAI MAIDEN".
The following updates have been made.

[h3]Update Information[/h3]

[b]●Game balance Improvements
-Enemy placement has been adjusted.
-The number of times you can start over at the restart point has been increased to three times when playing in Normal Mode.
-Combat evaluation criteria have been adjusted. The criteria for "Enemies Felled" and "Inga Acquired" have been revised downward.

●Tutorial Improvements
-New tutorial on "Ninja Skill" has been added.
-New tutorial on "Enhancing Weapons" has been added.

●Addition of "Enhancing Weapons" notification function
-When you have enough "Inga" to strengthen your weapon, a notification badge will appear in the Equip menu of the Camp.

●Addition of "Album" notification function
-When there are items that can be unlocked in the "Album", a notification badge will appear in the Album menu of the Camp.
[/b]
We look forward to your continued support of "SAMURAI MAIDEN".

Thanks!
Team Samurai Maiden
